title: Stop the free booking action from skipping a service deposit
detail: Deep audit 2026-11-19. createBooking (a public server action, the free confirm-only path) took any serviceTypeId and placed a CONFIRMED booking through validateAndPlaceBooking. The deposit path (startServiceDeposit: hold, then commerce checkout, then the settle webhook confirms) is chosen only by the booking widget in the browser, so a direct call with a paid service's id booked it with nothing paid once deposits go live. The guest door (createGuestBooking) already refused this; the member door did not. Fix: createBooking refuses a service with a linked product while bookingDepositsLive() is true. Free services and the dark period are unchanged. Live today: deposits are dark (bookingDepositsLive false), so no booking was taken this way; this closes it before payments turn on.

verify.note: Fails on main: createBooking places a booking with no deposit refusal. Passes when the refusal guards the placement.
